title: On Coming to the door at first light
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：come　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 come 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the writer ① came to the door at first light in silence, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the writer ② comes to the door at first light twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ come to the door at first light at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ come to the door at first light before — a line in the manuscript for January 1942 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Coming to the door at first light in silence, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ come from the far side of the river twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Come from the far side of the river at once and never mention it again.

By 1955 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a new reader from the next study ⑧ comes from the far side of the river in silence every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ came to the door at first light again when nobody else would.

⑩ To come to the door at first light, my mother said in 1960, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, somebody comes to the door at first light twice over again and somebody must come to the door at first light in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 到来（一般过去式 came to the door at first light：1948 年写作者头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 到来（一般现在 comes to the door at first light：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 到来（不定式 to come to the door at first light：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 到来（过去完成时 had come to the door at first light：1942 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 到来（动名词 coming to the door at first light 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 来到（come from the far side of the river：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去来到从河对岸过来）
G. v. 来到（come from the far side of the river：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 到来（后段两处：新来的读者照例 comes from the far side of the river，而母亲又一次 came to the door at first light）

answers.why: come 意为“到来”，1948 年写作者一言不发地到来天刚亮就来到门口，那是书斋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 came。
come 意为“到来”，自那以后写作者来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 comes。
come 意为“到来”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯到来天刚亮就来到门口”，此处为不定式 to come to the door at first light。
come 意为“到来”，手稿里 一月 那行字说明早在 1955 年之前就有人到来过，故用过去完成时 had come。
come 意为“到来”，写作者说“到来天刚亮就来到门口这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 coming to the door at first light 作主语。
come 意为“来到”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去来到从河对岸过来”，should ever 之后用原形 come from the far side of the river。
come 意为“来到”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻来到从河对岸过来（come from the far side of the river at once），以后再也不要提起。
come 意为“到来”，新来的读者每个月份都照例来到从河对岸过来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 comes。
come 意为“到来”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地到来天刚亮就来到门口，用一般过去式 came 叙述。
come 意为“到来”，结尾那句是母亲 1960 年的话：要到来天刚亮就来到门口，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和书斋记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，写作者一言不发地到来天刚亮就来到门口；书斋里每一个读者都说这是头一回。（came to the door at first light）
多年以后，写作者仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（comes to the door at first light）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯到来天刚亮就来到门口这件事本身。（to come to the door at first light）
早在 1942 年就有人到来天刚亮就来到门口，一月那天手稿上的一行字就是证据。（had come to the door at first light）
写作者说过，一言不发地到来天刚亮就来到门口这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（coming to the door at first light 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻来到从河对岸过来，以后再也不要提起。（come from the far side of the river，祈使句）
answers: In 1948 the writer came to the door at first light in silence, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the writer still comes to the door at first light twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to come to the door at first light at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had come to the door at first light long before 1955, and the line in the manuscript for January proves it.
Coming to the door at first light in silence, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Come from the far side of the river at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 come 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the writer came to the door at first light in silence, and nobody in the study forgot it.
Even now the writer comes to the door at first light twice over whenever the study asks.
Coming to the door at first light in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever come from the far side of the river twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new reader from the next study comes from the far side of the river in silence every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother came to the door at first light again, and the study remembered that half.
